summary: the upstream reference artefacts under rsc/reference, every lineage upstream publishes (bare: what upstream lists, what is held, what drifted)

urllib.request (GitHub contents and comm: lists the dated lineage directories a project's reference.json names, and reads the newest commit touching each fetched file - the pin (degrades to UNVERIFIED under YOGA_NO_SEND)
urllib.request (upstream raw files): reads every wanted file's live bytes at its pinned URL and hashes them against provenance.csv - the currency check (degrades to UNVERIFIED under YOGA_NO_SEND)
